evidence.statement: Annotation-blind scan found 54 exact unique 16-base strings shared across one bacterial, one archaeal, and one eukaryotic genome; it also found two nearby exact blocks with repeated ~3 kb spacing architecture.

After the sequence discovery was frozen, annotation identified the discovered regions with the 16S/23S large-ribosomal-RNA organizational system; the shared yeast core falls within mitochondrial 21S large-subunit rRNA.
This is consistent with an ancient reusable ribosomal infrastructure module recovered without a supplied biological ontology.

validated_components: yeast mitochondrial 21S large-subunit rRNA shared core

unknowns: Complete functional semantics of every discovered primitive are not established by this proof case.
